description: Comparing growth marketing agencies for startups? See pricing, vetting criteria, and the 5 models that work for Series A-C companies.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a growth marketing agency and a digital marketing agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: A growth marketing agency focuses on measurable acquisition and retention metrics — cost per lead, conversion rates, revenue per channel. A digital marketing agency often covers broader services including brand design, social media management, and PR. Growth agencies operate in test-and-iterate cycles and tie their work directly to pipeline.

mainEntity.name: How long should a startup commit to a growth marketing agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Give any growth marketing partner 60-90 days to show meaningful signal — not final ROI, but leading indicators like reduced cost per lead, improved conversion rates, or a functioning attribution setup. Avoid contracts longer than three months until those signals appear. Month-to-month engagements with clear 30/60/90-day milestones protect your downside.

mainEntity.name: Can a startup handle growth marketing without an agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, if you have at least one person with hands-on channel experience and 15-20 hours per week to dedicate. Many seed-stage startups rely on the founder plus one freelance digital marketing specialist. The risk is coverage gaps — paid acquisition, lifecycle, SEO, and analytics each require different skill sets.

mainEntity.name: What results should a startup expect from a growth marketing agency in the first 90 days?

acceptedAnswer.text: In the first 30 days: clean tracking, channel audit, and a prioritized test roadmap. By day 60: initial test results, baseline metrics established, and at least one channel showing positive signal. By day 90: a clear recommendation on which channels to scale and which to cut.

mainEntity.name: Is a fractional growth marketer better than an agency for startups?

acceptedAnswer.text: For most Series A-B startups, a fractional growth marketer delivers more value than an agency. You get a senior operator who owns strategy and execution — no handoff to junior staff, no split attention across fifteen accounts. The trade-off: a single fractional marketer can't cover five channels simultaneously.
